setup_audio_bridge: create an AudioBridge instance and call setup to provision a virtual audio device for Chrome fake-mic input
teardown_audio_bridge: call teardown on the AudioBridge instance to release the virtual audio device after the session ends
get_device_name: access the device_name property on AudioBridge to get the PulseAudio source name for Chrome env
get_write_target: access the write_target property on AudioBridge to get the null-sink name for writing PCM audio data
get_chrome_flags: call chrome_fake_audio_flags with the bridge info dict to get Chrome launch flags for fake media stream
